caption: Acies Triplex persistent line membership (#819): a checkerboard form-up stamps each unit's persistent Unit.line_index (0 = front, 1+ = reserve) as it splits into two offset lines -- the same tag then survives a unit-card-tray row move or grid reapply. The line-index bookkeeping itself has no on-screen representation yet (the flank-vulnerability/withdrawal mechanics that will read it are a later phase); this clip shows the checkerboard deploy that stamps it, verified separately by the unit tests.
